mechanism: hashCacheKey hashes inlineAttachments using only { name, mimeType, length }, omitting any hash or prefix/suffix digest of att.data.
recommendation: Include a fast FNV-1a or SHA-256 digest of att.data (or sampled slices + length) in the cache key so distinct images/PDFs with identical byte length and filename do not collide.

mechanism: When running multi-chunk cloud triage via Promise.all, resolvedSource is overwritten sequentially in the loop (resolvedSource = item.source), so mixed on_device/in_cloud chunk results only report the last chunk source.
recommendation: Aggregate chunk sources into an array or set; if any chunk used in_cloud, mark triageTelemetry.inferenceSource as in_cloud (or mixed) and record per-chunk provenance.

mechanism: probeTokenBudget only probes firstRequest (chunk 0) and then overwrites chunkInfo.estimatedTokens with tokenProbe.tokens, under-reporting total document tokens when chunkCount > 1.
recommendation: Keep chunkInfo.estimatedTokens for the full document and store the chunk-0 SDK probe separately or scale/sum across all chunks.

mechanism: Stage 0.5 semantic PII scrubbing skips whenever chromeNanoAvailability !== available, even when status is downloadable and could be initialized.
recommendation: Allow optional on-demand initializeDeviceModel() or surface a clear UI prompt to download Gemini Nano before skipping Stage 0.5.

mechanism: fallbackReason only checks prefer_on_device falling back to in_cloud, missing prefer_in_cloud falling back to on_device when offline.
recommendation: Add a branch for options.policyMode === prefer_in_cloud && resolvedSource === on_device to explain why cloud-preferred routing ran on-device.

mechanism: createClauseNegotiator forces effectiveMode = only_on_device when !params.isOnline without checking chromeNanoAvailability, which throws if modelFactory is called when Nano is unavailable.
recommendation: Check params.chromeNanoAvailability === available before forcing only_on_device in offline mode; otherwise fall back cleanly to local_heuristic.

mechanism: createClauseNegotiator pushes the user message into history before calling sendMessage/sendMessageStream; if AbortError is thrown, the aborted user turn remains orphaned in history.
recommendation: Pop the pending user message from history on AbortError or only commit it once the turn settles.

mechanism: parseSemanticPiiResponse falls back to rawText.indexOf({) .. rawText.lastIndexOf(}) when no code fence is found, which breaks if the model appends prose containing braces after the JSON.
recommendation: Use a balanced-brace JSON scanner (similar to extractPartialClausesFromStream) to extract the first complete JSON object.

mechanism: mergeChunkAnalyses deduplicates clauses using category + first 80 chars of normalizedExcerpt, causing distinct clauses with identical boilerplate prefixes to collide and drop.
recommendation: Hash or compare the full normalizedExcerpt (or first 160 chars + clause title) instead of truncating at 80 chars.

mechanism: mergeChunkAnalyses sums raw clause weights (28*critical + 18*high + 10*medium + 4*low) before clamping to 100, saturating at 100 on any multi-chunk document with 4+ findings.
recommendation: Use diminishing-returns scoring or average/weighted-max across chunks so risk scores remain calibrated between 0 and 100.

mechanism: computeHybridDelta sums semanticPii, triage, and escalation latencies but omits Stage 0 deterministic PII redaction latency.
recommendation: Measure Stage 0 redactSensitiveData duration in runHybridDocumentAnalysis and include it in telemetry/delta.

mechanism: buildEscalationPrompt silently truncates redactedText at 40,000 characters without setting a truncation flag or warning the user.
recommendation: Record escalationTruncated in chunkInfo/notes when redactedText.length > 40000 and surface it in the UI.

mechanism: IBAN rule uses /\b[A-Z]{2}\d{2}[A-Z0-9]{11,30}\b/g with no validate function, false-positiving on patent numbers, docket IDs, or tracking codes.
recommendation: Add an ISO 7064 mod-97 IBAN checksum validator function to the IBAN PatternRule.

mechanism: PEM_KEY regex requires -----END [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----, which misses PGP private key blocks (-----END PGP PRIVATE KEY BLOCK-----).
recommendation: Extend PEM_KEY regex to match optional BLOCK suffix: /-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY(?: BLOCK)?-----[\s\S]*?-----END [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY(?: BLOCK)?-----/g.

mechanism: IPV4 regex matches any 4-octet dotted quad including software version numbers (e.g. 2.0.1.4) and broadcast/wildcard addresses (0.0.0.0, 255.255.255.255).
recommendation: Add a validate helper or context filter to exclude common version-number prefixes (e.g. v1.2.3.4) and 0.0.0.0/255.255.255.255.

mechanism: ADDRESS regex only matches US street suffixes and US State + 5-digit ZIP, missing PO Boxes and international (UK/EU/CA) postal addresses.
recommendation: Add a dedicated PO Box pattern and optional UK/CA postcode patterns.

mechanism: EXISTING_TOKEN_RE is a module-level stateful /g regex; using .test() inside .filter() mutates lastIndex and relies on manual reset on line 334.
recommendation: Remove the g flag from EXISTING_TOKEN_RE when used for .test(), or construct a local non-global RegExp.

mechanism: mergeSemanticRedactions appends PiiMatch entries with start/end offsets relative to base.redactedText, whereas Stage 0 matches use offsets relative to base.originalText.
recommendation: Document the coordinate space on PiiMatch or compute/store originalText offsets consistently.

mechanism: API_SECRET regex matches sk-, AIza, ghp_, xox[baprs]-, Bearer/Basic, but misses GitLab (glpat-), Stripe webhook (whsec_), Slack webhook URLs, and npm (npm_) tokens.
recommendation: Add glpat-, whsec_, npm_, and AWS secret/session token patterns to API_SECRET.

mechanism: restoreFromVault regex lists all 17 categories explicitly; if a new PiiCategory is added in types/analysis.ts, restoreFromVault will silently fail to restore it.
recommendation: Match any [A-Z0-9_]+_\d+ token and check if it exists in vault (vault[token] ?? token).

mechanism: CATEGORY_ORDER, TOKEN_SPLIT_RE, and TOKEN_EXACT_RE omit PEM_KEY and IPV6, so PEM_KEY and IPV6 tokens are neither highlighted in the diff nor shown in category chips.
recommendation: Add PEM_KEY and IPV6 to CATEGORY_ORDER, TOKEN_SPLIT_RE, and TOKEN_EXACT_RE.

mechanism: handleCopyRedacted silently swallows clipboard write errors without notifying the user.
recommendation: Show a brief error or fallback message when navigator.clipboard.writeText rejects.

mechanism: Normalization for deduplicating tokens only lowercases EMAIL and IPV4, so identical PHONE formats (+1-555-123-4567 vs +1 555 123 4567) or IPV6 case variants get separate tokens.
recommendation: Normalize IPV6 to lowercase and PHONE to digits-only for deduplication keys.

mechanism: h-liability heuristic only checks $100 cap (exceed \$?100|cap of \$?100), missing other nominal caps like $500, $1,000, $0, or 1-month fee caps.
recommendation: Expand h-liability regex to catch nominal dollar caps ($0-$1,000) and 1-month/3-month fee caps.

mechanism: h-auto-renew heuristic checks 60-day and 90-day notice windows, missing 30-day and 45-day mandatory advance notice traps.
recommendation: Include 30|45|60|90 days notice patterns in h-auto-renew.

mechanism: extractSentenceExcerpt splits on (?:\.\s+(?=[A-Z])|\n), which truncates excerpts prematurely at legal abbreviations like Inc., Corp., Ltd., U.S., Art., Sec.
recommendation: Use a negative lookbehind or abbreviation allowlist before splitting on period + space + capital letter.

mechanism: Negation/carve-out guards only cover 6 of 13 heuristic rules, leaving h-uncapped-indemnity, h-liquidated-damages, h-mfn, h-non-compete, and h-moral-rights prone to false positives on negated clauses.
recommendation: Add negation/carve-out checks (e.g. shall not be subject to liquidated damages, no non-compete) for the remaining 7 rules.

mechanism: Cross-clause synthesis in analyzeDocumentHeuristically only checks for exact clause ID h-liability, h-ai-training, etc., missing -2/-3 suffixed IDs if multiple matches occurred.
recommendation: Check clauses.some(c => c.id.startsWith(h-liability)) instead of strict equality.

mechanism: ON_DEVICE_JSON_CONSTRAINT defines crossClauseFindings items with summary and recommendation, whereas DOCUMENT_ANALYSIS_SCHEMA and CrossClauseFinding use impact and negotiationMove.
recommendation: Align ON_DEVICE_JSON_CONSTRAINT crossClauseFindings properties to impact and negotiationMove so on-device output parses without losing fields.

mechanism: extractPartialClausesFromStream searches for the literal key "clauses", which fails if a string earlier in the JSON contains "clauses".
recommendation: Locate "clauses" only at top-level JSON depth 1.

mechanism: parseStructuredAnalysis trusts parsed.riskPosture verbatim if valid, even when it contradicts overallRiskScore (e.g. score 90 with posture Low).
recommendation: Derive riskPosture from overallRiskScore whenever the model-supplied posture disagrees with the score tier.

mechanism: HEURISTIC_RULES lacks rules for Governing Law / Foreign Jurisdiction traps and Subprocessor / Third-Party Data Sharing without consent.
recommendation: Add heuristic rules for foreign/inconvenient governing law and unrestricted subprocessor/data-sharing.

mechanism: normalizeCrossFindings does not deduplicate identical cross-clause findings emitted by the model.
recommendation: Deduplicate crossClauseFindings by normalized title.

mechanism: Sample documents are bundled eagerly into the main JS chunk even when the user immediately uploads their own file.
recommendation: Lazy-load sampleDocuments.ts or keep only metadata eager and load full sample text on selection.

mechanism: replaceInDocxParagraphs collapses all <w:r> runs in a matched paragraph into a single <w:r> using only the first <w:rPr>, destroying bold/italic/underline/hyperlink formatting on subsequent runs in that paragraph.
recommendation: Preserve run boundaries where possible or map character offsets across <w:t> nodes to only replace the matched substring.

mechanism: exportDocx only modifies word/document.xml, ignoring headers (word/header*.xml), footers (word/footer*.xml), and footnotes.
recommendation: Iterate over word/header*.xml and word/footer*.xml in the zip archive if present.

mechanism: exportPdf strips all non-ASCII characters ([^\x20-\x7E]) to spaces after basic Latin-1 replacements, silently corrupting bullet points, trademark/copyright symbols, and non-English names.
recommendation: Map common symbols (bullet, TM, (c), (R), Yen) to ASCII equivalents or embed a Unicode-capable font.

mechanism: wrapLine splits on whitespace and pushes any single word/URL longer than maxWidth without breaking it, causing long URLs or tokens to overflow the right PDF margin.
recommendation: Add character-level hard wrapping when measureWidth(word) > maxWidth.

mechanism: replaceExcerptInText builds a RegExp from cleanExcerpt.split(/\s+/) without capping word count, which can create a massive regex on long excerpts.
recommendation: Guard flexRe construction with a max token length or catch RegExp errors.

mechanism: MAX_LCS_CELLS = 2_000_000 allocates a Uint32Array of up to 8 MB on the main thread synchronously, which can cause a brief UI jank on large contracts.
recommendation: Lower MAX_LCS_CELLS or run computeWordDiff inside a Web Worker / chunked async task for large documents.

mechanism: extractPdfTextLocally joins all text items on a page with single spaces, losing paragraph breaks and table/column structure.
recommendation: Use item.hasEOL or Y-coordinate deltas between PDF text items to preserve line and paragraph breaks.

mechanism: ingestUploadedFile does not check if a PDF is scanned/image-only (extracted text.trim().length === 0) and returns empty text without warning or offering image/OCR fallback.
recommendation: Detect empty/near-empty PDF text extraction and surface a clear notice suggesting screenshot/image upload for multimodal OCR.

mechanism: No max file size guard on image/PDF/DOCX ingestion, so a 100MB+ file will attempt base64 encoding or full in-memory arrayBuffer allocation and freeze the tab.
recommendation: Enforce a sensible client-side size limit (e.g. 25MB) with a clear error message.

mechanism: ContractDiffView defaults displayMode to clean, hiding the word-level redline diff unless the user manually checks Show changes.
recommendation: Consider defaulting to diff when compiled.appliedCount > 0 so users immediately see their accepted redlines.

mechanism: exportEditedDocument only uses exportDocx when options.originalBuffer is present; if a user reloads a DOCX scan from Local History (where originalBuffer is not persisted), it silently falls back to plain text/markdown.
recommendation: Notify the user or allow choosing export format explicitly when originalBuffer is unavailable.

mechanism: window.FIREBASE_APPCHECK_DEBUG_TOKEN is only assigned when import.meta.env?.DEV is true, so vite preview or staging builds ignore VITE_APPCHECK_DEBUG_TOKEN while appCheckStatus.mode still reports debug-token.
recommendation: Either allow debug token assignment when VITE_APPCHECK_DEBUG_TOKEN is explicitly set (with a console warning) or reflect in appCheckStatus that debug tokens are disabled in production builds.

mechanism: modelCache key is ${effectiveMode}::${schemaKey} without cloudModel, risking stale model instances if config changes without re-initializing.
recommendation: Include config.cloudModel in modelCache key.

mechanism: buildHybridParams passes inCloudParams even when mode is only_on_device.
recommendation: Omit inCloudParams when effectiveMode === only_on_device.

mechanism: buildScanHistoryRecord omits crossClauseFindings when creating a ScanHistoryRecord, even though ScanHistoryRecord defines crossClauseFindings and reconstructReportFromHistory reads it.
recommendation: Include crossClauseFindings: activeAnalysis.crossClauseFindings (sanitized via scrubText) in buildScanHistoryRecord.

mechanism: openHistoryDb caches cachedDbPromise forever once resolved; if the IndexedDB connection closes unexpectedly (onclose/onversionchange), subsequent transactions will fail.
recommendation: Attach db.onclose and db.onversionchange listeners to clear cachedDbPromise.

mechanism: buildMultimodalContentParts does not validate that InlineAttachment.mimeType is a supported Gemini inlineData MIME type.
recommendation: Filter or validate mimeType against supported image/PDF types before pushing inlineData parts.

mechanism: APP_CHECK_TOKEN_TIMEOUT_MS is hardcoded to 5000ms; slow mobile networks may time out before reCAPTCHA finishes loading.
recommendation: Make timeout configurable or increase to 8000ms.

mechanism: If getApps().length > 0, initializeFirebaseServices reuses getApp() even if configSignature changed, rather than checking if options match.
recommendation: Compare existing app.options with config.firebaseOptions or document single-app constraint.

mechanism: createRecordId fallback uses Date.now() + Math.random() when crypto.randomUUID is unavailable.
recommendation: Acceptable fallback, but ensure uniqueness under rapid batch saves.

mechanism: scrubText runs redactDocument(value) without customTerms, so user-defined custom confidential terms are not scrubbed from saved IndexedDB history.
recommendation: Pass active customTerms into buildScanHistoryRecord / sanitizeScanRecord.

mechanism: install event uses cache.addAll(PRECACHE_URLS), which fails the entire service worker installation atomically if any single precache URL fails.
recommendation: Use Promise.allSettled with individual cache.add() calls or ensure all PRECACHE_URLS exist in dist/.

mechanism: PRECACHE_URLS caches /icons/icon-192.svg and icon-512.svg, but omits /icons/icon-192.png, /icons/icon-512.png, and /icons/legalease-logo.jpg.
recommendation: Add the PNG icons and logo to PRECACHE_URLS so offline installs have all brand assets.

mechanism: Navigation handler caches any 200 basic response under /index.html, even if the URL was a sub-route.
recommendation: Only update /index.html cache when url.pathname === / or /index.html.

mechanism: Stale-while-revalidate caches hashed /assets/* indefinitely under CACHE_VERSION without ever pruning old hashed assets on app updates.
recommendation: Bump CACHE_VERSION on release or implement an LRU/max-entries cap for /assets/*.

mechanism: BYPASS_HOST_PATTERN is redundant with url.origin !== self.location.origin on line 55.
recommendation: Keep or clarify comment, or add same-origin /__/auth/ or /__/firebase/ bypass if hosted on Firebase Hosting.

mechanism: App.tsx listens for serviceWorker controllerchange and ready, but never calls navigator.serviceWorker.register(/sw.js) itself (relying on main.tsx); if registration fails, offlineShellReady stays false silently.
recommendation: Expose registration status/error in Diagnostics drawer.

mechanism: Offline fallback returns plain text LocalShield offline shell unavailable. instead of a minimal styled HTML page.
recommendation: Return a clean offline HTML fallback with Content-Type: text/html.

mechanism: In stale-while-revalidate, void cache.put(...) is not awaited inside event.respondWith, so the browser may terminate the SW before the cache write completes.
recommendation: Use event.waitUntil(networkPromise) so the SW stays alive until cache.put finishes.

mechanism: beforeinstallprompt is captured in deferredInstallPrompt, but there is no dismissal tracking if the user declines the install prompt.
recommendation: Persist install prompt dismissal state in localStorage so the install button does not nag repeatedly.

mechanism: STATIC_ASSET_PATTERN matches .mjs files, which covers pdf.worker.min.mjs, but only if it is fetched at least once while online.
recommendation: Precache or warm-fetch the PDF.js worker URL on SW install or app idle.

mechanism: configureSidePanelBehavior() only runs on script load and onInstalled, not on chrome.runtime.onStartup.
recommendation: Register chrome.runtime.onStartup.addListener(configureSidePanelBehavior) as well.

mechanism: runAuditOnText creates abortControllerRef.current but never passes signal: controller.signal into runHybridDocumentAnalysis options.
recommendation: Pass signal: controller.signal to runHybridDocumentAnalysis so aborting actually cancels in-flight model calls.

mechanism: chrome.scripting.executeScript slices document.body.innerText to 28,000 characters, silently truncating long Terms of Service or Privacy Policies.
recommendation: Increase limit or notify the user in the side panel when the extracted page text was truncated.

mechanism: Extension manifest does not request storage permission, so user preferences (policyMode, customTerms) reset every time the side panel closes.
recommendation: Add storage permission and persist policyChoice and customTermsInput in chrome.storage.local.

mechanism: executeScript extracts document.body.innerText without checking if the user has a text selection (window.getSelection()?.toString()), missing a common workflow of auditing selected clauses.
recommendation: Prefer non-empty window.getSelection()?.toString() or offer a Scan Selection vs Scan Full Page toggle.

mechanism: isRestrictedUrl checks chrome:, edge:, about:, devtools:, chrome-extension:, view-source:, but misses file:// URLs (blocked unless user enables Allow access to file URLs) and Chrome Web Store (https://chromewebstore.google.com).
recommendation: Handle Chrome Web Store URLs and file:// permission errors gracefully in the catch block.

mechanism: buildCompactBriefMarkdown omits crossClauseFindings and complianceFlags from the exported side-panel brief.
recommendation: Include complianceFlags and crossClauseFindings sections in buildCompactBriefMarkdown.

mechanism: useSimulatedSandbox is hardcoded to !firebaseHandle with no toggle in the side panel UI.
recommendation: Add a Sandbox toggle in SidePanelApp so users with Firebase configured can still test sandbox mode.

mechanism: copyExtensionStaticAssets does not verify that dist-extension/background.js and sidepanel.html exist or match manifest.json.
recommendation: Add a post-build assertion in closeBundle() to fail fast if required manifest entrypoints are missing.

mechanism: Extension manifest has no content_security_policy explicitly declared (relies on MV3 default).
recommendation: Explicitly declare extension_pages CSP in manifest.json for defense in depth.

mechanism: draftRedline state is initialized once from effectiveRedline; if the parent updates decision.customRedline externally (e.g. from ClauseNegotiationDrawer), draftRedline is stale until handleStartEdit.
recommendation: Sync draftRedline in handleStartEdit and also reset isEditing if clause.id changes.

mechanism: sendPrompt appends optimisticUser to messages, and on AbortError/failure does not remove optimisticUser, leaving a dangling user message in UI state.
recommendation: Sync messages from negotiatorRef.current.getHistory() in finally or roll back optimisticUser on AbortError.

mechanism: ClauseNegotiationDrawer has no Escape key handler or backdrop click-to-close.
recommendation: Add Escape key listener and backdrop click handler matching LocalHistoryDrawer.

mechanism: Clear All History button immediately deletes all saved scans without a confirmation step.
recommendation: Add a two-click confirm state or window.confirm guard before clearing all history.

mechanism: Body scroll-lock effect tracks diagnosticsOpen, historyOpen, and privacyDrawerOpen, but omits negotiatingClause !== null (ClauseNegotiationDrawer).
recommendation: Include Boolean(negotiatingClause) in anyDrawerOpen so background scrolling is locked when negotiating a clause.

mechanism: _removeCustomTerm is defined with void _removeCustomTerm, indicating dead/unused code in App.tsx.
recommendation: Remove _removeCustomTerm if unused or wire it to the custom term chip remove button.

mechanism: Throttled partial clause parsing uses Date.now() and setTimeout(150 - elapsed), but does not clear partialClauses when isAnalyzing becomes false.
recommendation: Clear partialClauses when analysis completes or is cancelled.

mechanism: combinedLatencyMs and combinedTokens exclude semanticPii.latencyMs, slightly differing from HybridDeltaPanel.
recommendation: Include semanticPii?.latencyMs ?? 0 in combinedLatencyMs for consistency.

mechanism: handleCopy sets a 1600ms timeout to reset copied without storing/clearing the timer on unmount.
recommendation: Store timeout ID in a ref and clear on unmount.

mechanism: Tablist for Merged / Stage 1 / Stage 2 lacks ArrowLeft/ArrowRight keyboard navigation per WAI-ARIA tabs pattern.
recommendation: Add onKeyDown arrow-key switching between tabs.

mechanism: displayRedaction falls back to liveRedaction if report.redaction.originalText !== documentText, but if customTerms changed after report ran, displayRedaction still shows stale report.redaction.
recommendation: Invalidate or warn when effectiveCustomTerms change after a report was generated.

mechanism: Word-level diff renders every segment as a separate DOM node; on very large documents with thousands of segments, this can slow down React reconciliation.
recommendation: Memoize segment rendering or cap rendered diff segments with an expand-all toggle.

mechanism: No unit tests cover PEM_KEY, IPV6, or IBAN false-positive rejection (e.g. patent/docket IDs) in piiRedactor.ts.
recommendation: Add test cases for PEM_KEY (including PGP), IPV6, and IBAN mod-97 validation.

mechanism: No test verifies that two distinct inlineAttachments with identical name, mimeType, and byte length do not collide in hybridAnalysisCache.
recommendation: Add a cache-collision regression test for inlineAttachments.

mechanism: No test verifies createClauseNegotiator behavior when !isOnline and chromeNanoAvailability is unavailable.
recommendation: Add a test asserting createClauseNegotiator falls back to local_heuristic when offline and Nano is unavailable.

mechanism: No test verifies DOCX export preserves formatting or handles headers/footers, nor PDF export wrapping of ultra-long URLs.
recommendation: Add DOCX multi-run preservation and PDF long-URL wrapping tests.

mechanism: scanHistory tests do not verify that crossClauseFindings are preserved across buildScanHistoryRecord -> reconstructReportFromHistory.
recommendation: Add a round-trip test for crossClauseFindings in scanHistory.test.ts.

mechanism: No test verifies extractSentenceExcerpt behavior on legal abbreviations like Inc., Corp., U.S., Art., Sec.
recommendation: Add abbreviation-handling test cases in analysisParser.test.ts.

mechanism: No test covers empty/scanned PDF detection or oversized file rejection in ingestUploadedFile.
recommendation: Add unit tests for 0-text PDFs and max file size enforcement.

mechanism: No test verifies ON_DEVICE_JSON_CONSTRAINT and DOCUMENT_ANALYSIS_SCHEMA field parity for crossClauseFindings.
recommendation: Add a schema parity assertion in firebaseClient.test.ts.

mechanism: Service worker fetch/install/activate logic has zero automated unit tests.
recommendation: Add a lightweight Node/Vitest mock test for sw.js routing and precache behavior.

mechanism: Chrome extension SidePanelApp and background.ts have no automated tests.
recommendation: Add Vitest tests for mapPolicyChoice, isRestrictedUrl, and buildCompactBriefMarkdown.

mechanism: vite.config.ts defines no build.rollupOptions.output.manualChunks, causing firebase, pdfjs-dist, mammoth, pdf-lib, and jszip to bundle into large monolithic chunks.
recommendation: Configure manualChunks to split firebase, pdfjs-dist, and document-export/ingest libraries into cacheable vendor chunks.

mechanism: documentExporter.ts (which imports jszip and pdf-lib) is statically imported at the top of App.tsx, increasing initial bundle parse time even before the user exports anything.
recommendation: Dynamically import ./lib/documentExporter inside the export handler.

mechanism: documentIngestor.ts is statically imported in App.tsx, pulling pdfWorkerUrl asset reference into the main entry chunk.
recommendation: Dynamically import ./lib/documentIngestor on file drop/select.

mechanism: sourcemap: true is enabled in production Vite build, increasing dist/ size and exposing full TypeScript sources in static deployments.
recommendation: Use sourcemap: hidden or false for production builds.

mechanism: build:extension script runs vite build --config vite.extension.config.ts without running tsc --noEmit first.
recommendation: Chain tsc --noEmit && vite build --config vite.extension.config.ts so type errors fail extension builds.

mechanism: arrayBufferToBase64 builds a concatenated string in 8192-byte chunks, which is O(N) but creates intermediate string allocations for large images.
recommendation: Use FileReader.readAsDataURL() in browser environments for native C++ base64 encoding.

mechanism: liveRedaction runs redactDocument(documentText, { customTerms }) synchronously on every keystroke in the document editor.
recommendation: Debounce documentText redaction (e.g. 150-250ms) for large documents (>20KB) to keep typing at 60fps.

mechanism: package.json name is localshield-hybrid-doc-brief while extension/manifest.json and UI titles use LegalEase.
recommendation: Align package.json name/description or document the dual branding clearly.
